description: This is a Python source file containing utilities and classes for model weight and activation comparison, logging, and model instrumentation within a quantization framework, specifically for TorchFX models. It includes classes for capturing intermediate outputs, functions for extracting weight and activation comparisons, and utilities for adding loggers and shadow models to facilitate model analysis and testing.

classes.name: OutputLogger
classes.description: Captures intermediate activations and supports comparison with reference activations for analysis during model quantization.

classes.name: OutputComparisonLogger
classes.description: Extends OutputLogger with additional capabilities to compare current and reference activations, computing metrics like SQNR.

classes.name: NSTracer
classes.description: Custom FX tracer that treats observer and fake quantize modules as leaf modules during tracing.
